app.title: AI-Powered Conversational Intelligence
app.subtitle: Ask a question in plain English — get validated, read-only SQL, a live result table, and an auto-picked chart.

auth.localRegisterSubtitle: Sign up to start asking questions.
auth.localSwitchToRegister: Don't have an account? Sign up

sql.title: Generated SQL
sql.hint: Edit if needed — it will be re-validated and re-run when you click Confirm and Run.

results.title: Results
results.noSuitableChart: No suitable chart for this result shape.

chart.selectValidColumns: Select a valid column combination to preview the chart.
chart.truncatedNotice: This chart reflects only the returned rows -- the result may have been truncated by the row limit.

feedback.question: Was this SQL correct?
feedback.savedToast: Saved — future similar questions will use this as a reference example.
feedback.detailsPlaceholder: What was helpful, or what could be improved?
feedback.privacyNotice: This saves your question, this answer, and your comment together so the team can review it and improve future answers. Nothing is sent to a third party.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Sources

knowledge.nothingIngested: Nothing ingested into this collection yet.
knowledge.disabled: This collection is disabled. Enable it in your .env configuration.

image.dropHint: Drop images here, or click to browse
image.pasteHint: You can also paste an image from your clipboard
image.errorTooLarge: That file is larger than 10 MB.
image.errorUnsupportedType: That doesn't look like a supported image (PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or GIF).
image.errorCorrupt: That file couldn't be read as an image.
image.errorDimensionsTooLarge: That image's dimensions are too large.
image.errorTooMany: You can attach up to {{max}} images.

image.aiPresetReplaceSky: Replace the sky with a sunset
image.aiPresetExtractTable: Extract the selected table or chart
image.aiNotConfigured: AI-guided editing is not configured on this server. Your local edits above are unaffected.

image.extractHint: Recognizes on-screen text via OCR — analysis only, never a generated image. Crop first to isolate one table or chart.
image.extractedTextEmpty: No text was recognized in this image.

attachments.processingFailed: This file could not be processed.
attachments.errorTooLarge: That file is larger than 25 MB.
attachments.errorTooMany: You can attach up to {{max}} files.
